topic: Figarland Garling pitched and profited from the God Valley hunt, killed a defeated Rocks for the credit, and the World Government rewarded him all the way to the Five Elders
title: Garling Led God Valley, Then Got Promoted For It
description:
Garling and the God Valley Incident, chapter by chapter: how Figarland Garling found the Davy Family, pitched the Native Hunting Competition to the Five Elders, left the mother of his sons to fall, and was named champion of God Valley. Decades later he sits among the Five Elders. Was he ever punished for any of it, or only promoted?

2:00 The Woman He Left
3:20 The Opening Ceremony
5:00 Pirates On The Beach
6:30 The Finish He Didn't Earn
8:00 Decades Of Reward

10:50 Where This Goes
comment: Was Garling ever the hero of God Valley, or just the last man standing when the credit got handed out?

lines.text: Garling designed the God Valley hunt, took the credit when it burned, and got promoted for it.

shot.search: Garling God Valley Knight of God
shot.fallback: cold noble knight overlooking a burning island

lines.text: He abandoned the mother of his sons, then rose to sit among the five rulers of the world.

shot.fallback: noble knight drawing a sword on a woman

lines.text: So how does a man like that get rewarded instead of punished?

shot.search: Garling Five Elders Room of Authority
shot.fallback: five elders in a dark chamber

lines.text: I'll show you the chapters that prove he chose the island, the victims and the prize himself.

shot.fallback: nobles watching a hunt from a stage

lines.text: Chapter 1158 shows him pitching the whole thing to the Five Elders. Chapter 1166 shows who got the final blow...

shot.search: Garling Five Elders God Valley proposal
shot.fallback: noble reporting to five elders

lines.text: The pitch is the polite part.

shot.fallback: knight standing over a fallen pirate

lines.text: Because the island he picked already had a woman on it who trusted him...

shot.fallback: red haired woman smiling at a noble

lines.text: Forty years ago, Garling lands on God Valley as a Knight of God, fresh from another assignment.

shot.search: Garling arrives God Valley Knights of God
shot.fallback: knights stepping off a ship onto a green island

lines.text: He sees rich resources and a culture nobody has tamed, so he offers the island a place in the World Government.

shot.fallback: lush valley island with strange culture

lines.text: The islanders say no. According to Chapter 1158, the two sides can't reach an agreement.

shot.search: God Valley king refuses World Government
shot.fallback: island king refusing a noble

lines.text: A refusal like that is all he needs.

shot.fallback: noble smirking coldly

lines.text: While he's there, he also finds the Davy Family hiding on the island.

shot.fallback: hidden clan living in a valley

lines.text: Here's the detail people skip: he doesn't report a problem. He reports a gift.

shot.search: Garling reports Five Elders Davy Family
shot.fallback: noble kneeling before elders

lines.text: Back in Mary Geoise, he tells the Five Elders that what he found will please Imu.

shot.search: Garling Mary Geoise Five Elders meeting
shot.fallback: knight addressing five seated elders

lines.text: Then he urges them to make God Valley the site of the next Native Hunting Competition.

shot.search: Native Hunting Competition announcement God Valley
shot.fallback: elders approving a cruel hunt

lines.text: I think that's the moment the tragedy becomes his design, because nobody else proposes it.

shot.fallback: shadowed knight shaping a plan

lines.text: The official excuse, from Chapter 1095, is that the island's name sounds blasphemous to the Celestial Dragons.

shot.search: God Valley name blasphemous Celestial Dragons
shot.fallback: nobles scoffing at an island name

lines.text: That's cover. The real reasons are resources, a rejected offer, and a hidden family line.

shot.search: God Valley Incident Davy Family purge
shot.fallback: hidden family line hunted by nobles

lines.text: A year earlier, Shakuyaku is kidnapped from Hachinosu at Garling's request, so he can win her as his bride.

shot.fallback: woman carried away from a pirate town

lines.text: He isn't just attending the hunt. He's arranging for the prize to land in his own hands.

shot.fallback: noble claiming a woman as a prize

lines.text: And the woman who already loved him is about to learn what that means...

shot.search: Magnolia twins Shamrock Shanks God Valley
shot.fallback: red haired woman holding twin boys

lines.text: Garling's lover on God Valley is Magnolia, a common woman from the West Blue.

shot.fallback: red haired woman on a hillside

lines.text: She never learns his rank. She believes he'll come back and live with her and their sons.

shot.fallback: woman waiting by the sea hopefully

lines.text: Their twin boys are Shamrock and Shanks, confirmed as his sons in Chapters 1137 and 1138.

shot.fallback: two red haired boys side by side

lines.text: A year later, Garling returns, and Magnolia proudly introduces him to the boys.

shot.fallback: noble looking down at two toddlers

lines.text: He calls them adorable. Then he tells her the island won't exist much longer.

shot.search: Garling tells Magnolia God Valley destroyed
shot.fallback: noble speaking coldly to a woman

lines.text: He's already arranged a real bride, Shakuyaku. Magnolia was never part of the plan.

shot.fallback: noble dismissing a woman

lines.text: Before she can react, he stabs her and orders the Marines to move in. That's Chapter 1160.

shot.search: Garling confronts Magnolia Marines move in
shot.fallback: knight confronting a woman, marines advancing

lines.text: He doesn't check whether she's dead. He treats her like something already thrown away.

shot.fallback: knight walking away from a fallen woman

lines.text: She lives long enough to reach a young Marine cadet, Monkey D. Dragon, and beg him to save her children.

shot.fallback: young marine cadet kneeling by a fallen woman

lines.text: I find it grimly funny that this cadet will go on to build the army that hunts Garling's government.

shot.search: Monkey D. Dragon young Marine God Valley
shot.fallback: young marine cadet horrified

lines.text: But the hunt hasn't even started yet, and the next scene shows who signs off on it...

shot.fallback: grand stage with nobles cheering

lines.text: On the day, around two hundred Nobles show up, plus about a hundred thousand civilians marked as Rabbits.

shot.search: Native Hunting Competition Rabbits civilians nobles
shot.fallback: crowd of captured civilians on an island

lines.text: There are also a hundred and fifty Rare Rabbits and thirteen Super Rare ones, per Chapter 1096.

shot.search: Super Rare Rabbits Native Hunting Competition
shot.fallback: list of prize targets on a board

lines.text: The Super Rares include Bartholomew Kuma and members of the Davy Family, paraded in front of the crowd.

shot.search: Kuma Davy Family paraded hunting competition
shot.fallback: prisoners paraded before cheering nobles

lines.text: Saturn of the Five Elders is watching. When the Davy Family is presented, he praises Garling's find.

shot.fallback: elder nodding approval at a knight

lines.text: Garling shrugs it off as fate. Chapter 1160 plays it as a throwaway, but I'd call it the receipt.

shot.fallback: knight shrugging at an elder's praise

lines.text: A sitting Elder commends him for it. In that room, nobody sees a crime.

shot.fallback: elder watching with cold approval

lines.text: Shakky is presented as the grand prize, and Garling instantly argues with Shepherd Sommers over who gets her as a bride.

shot.search: Shakky grand prize Garling Sommers argue
shot.fallback: two knights quarreling over a woman

lines.text: Think about those priorities. A hunt of civilians is about to begin and two Knights of God are bickering over a wife.

shot.fallback: two knights bickering on a stage

lines.text: Then Garling kills the island's king, who protested his people being used as game.

shot.fallback: knight cutting down an old king

lines.text: The rules hand him a ten thousand point penalty for killing before the timer starts.

shot.fallback: scoreboard with a negative score

lines.text: He treats it like a handicap that makes the contest more fun.

shot.fallback: noble laughing at a penalty

lines.text: That's what the system does to a man who wrongs a king: it deducts points from a scoreboard.

shot.fallback: cold scoreboard glowing above a crowd

lines.text: And the deduction barely slows him down. Chapter 1096 shows him as the favorite, going straight for the high value Rabbits.

shot.fallback: knight riding a bird across a battlefield

lines.text: The whole thing is broadcast live to Mary Geoise, so everyone above him gets to watch.

shot.search: Native Hunting Competition broadcast Mary Geoise
shot.fallback: nobles watching a live broadcast

lines.text: So the question isn't whether Garling was cruel. It's who else was watching, and who cheered.

shot.fallback: crowd of nobles cheering a aftermath

lines.text: But then the pirates land, and Garling's loyalty gets tested in a way he handles very badly...

shot.search: Rocks Pirates Roger Pirates land God Valley
shot.fallback: pirate ships storming an island from two sides

lines.text: The Rocks Pirates come from the south and the Roger Pirates from the north, and the hunt collapses.

shot.search: Rocks Pirates Roger Pirates invade God Valley
shot.fallback: two pirate fleets landing on a beach

lines.text: Garling is irritated, not scared. He orders the Marines to pull back and guard the Celestial Dragons.

shot.search: Garling orders Marines pull back guard nobles
shot.fallback: knight commanding marines to retreat

lines.text: The Knights of God will handle the pirates themselves.

shot.search: Knights of God God Valley pirates
shot.fallback: armored knights facing pirates

lines.text: Which means the hundred thousand civilians he was hunting are nobody's priority.

shot.fallback: abandoned civilians on a battlefield

lines.text: Meanwhile, Dragon tranquilizes a Noble about to kill Kuma, defying his orders.

shot.fallback: young marine shooting a dart at a noble

lines.text: In the chaos, Dragon flees with Shanks while Saint Maffey takes Shamrock.

shot.search: Dragon Shanks Maffey Shamrock God Valley
shot.fallback: two figures each carrying a baby apart

lines.text: Maffey never realizes there were twins, so she assumes her mission is complete.

shot.fallback: woman noble holding a baby coldly

lines.text: That's the quiet reason Shanks lives. A gap in a Noble's attention, not mercy.

shot.fallback: marine cadet carrying a baby through smoke

lines.text: Then Garling meets Rocks D. Xebec, and Chapter 1162 is not kind to him.

shot.fallback: huge pirate captain facing a knight

lines.text: Rocks is trying to escape with his wife and son, and Garling's group blocks the way.

shot.search: Rocks Eris Teach escape God Valley
shot.fallback: pirate captain protecting wife and baby

lines.text: Davy Family members are turned into demons and sent at Rocks, so he has to fight his own relatives.

shot.fallback: demonic family members attacking a pirate

lines.text: Garling notes that Rocks' swordsmanship slows their regeneration, then decides killing him will please Imu.

shot.fallback: knight watching his scars heal slowly

lines.text: But Garling's overconfidence loses the fight. Rocks beats him and his allies quickly and leaves him grievously hurt.

shot.search: Rocks defeats Garling Knights of God
shot.fallback: tired knights lying around a pirate captain

lines.text: So the man the Nobles call their champion loses his own fight. Hold on to that when you hear the title.

shot.fallback: tired noble knight on the ground

lines.text: Because the title isn't earned in that fight. It's earned in the next one...

shot.fallback: shadowy king possessing an elder

lines.text: Imu possesses Saturn and joins the battle, then turns Rocks into a demon, per Chapters 1162 and 1163.

shot.search: Imu possesses Saturn turns Rocks demon
shot.fallback: shadowy king twisting a pirate into a demon

lines.text: Roger and Garp are forced to fight Rocks together, and it nearly kills them both.

shot.fallback: two men fighting a giant demon together

lines.text: The Rocks Pirates lose faith in their captain and begin to disband.

shot.search: Rocks Pirates disband Newgate Kaidou Linlin
shot.fallback: pirates sailing away from their captain

lines.text: Rocks wins back his own mind for a moment, and in Chapter 1166 he silently thanks Roger and Garp.

shot.fallback: pirate captain smiling in defeat

lines.text: Roger and Garp collapse from exhaustion. The men who actually ended the fight are lying in the dirt.

shot.fallback: two exhausted fighters collapsing

lines.text: That's when Garling, Maffey and Sommers walk up.

shot.fallback: three nobles walking toward a fallen man

lines.text: Garling steps forward, with two Knights beside him, and delivers the killing blow to a defeated man.

shot.search: Garling faces Rocks D. Xebec sword
shot.fallback: knight driving a sword into a fallen captain

lines.text: He doesn't win a duel. He finishes an exhausted man after two others did the work.

shot.fallback: knight standing over a fallen captain

lines.text: Then Imu orders God Valley destroyed, and Marine battleships erase the island.

shot.fallback: battleships bombarding a collapsing island

lines.text: The story gets rewritten. Garp becomes the Hero of the Marines, a title he hates.

shot.search: Garp Hero of the Marines God Valley
shot.fallback: old marine hero looking troubled

lines.text: Roger's role is hidden. Imu's role is hidden. And Garling is declared the champion of God Valley.

shot.fallback: knight crowned as a champion

lines.text: Garp turns down promotions to Admiral because he refuses to be the Nobles' direct subordinate.

shot.fallback: old marine refusing a rank

lines.text: Garling takes the opposite road. He keeps the title, and the title keeps paying.

shot.fallback: knight in black coat looking proud

lines.text: His son Shanks ends up in a chest the Roger Pirates carry away, and Garling won't see him for decades...

shot.search: baby Shanks treasure chest Roger Pirates
shot.fallback: baby in an open treasure chest

lines.text: Decades pass. Garling rises to Supreme Commander of the Knights of God.

shot.search: Garling Supreme Commander Knights of God
shot.fallback: knight commander in red and black coat

lines.text: From that chair he can pass judgment on any World Noble whose behavior he deems intolerable, per Chapter 1054.

shot.fallback: knight commander judging nobles

lines.text: What counts as intolerable to him? Look at the case of Saint Mjosgard.

shot.fallback: noble on trial before a stern knight

lines.text: After the latest Levely, Garling judges Mjosgard for helping pirates escape and executes him for protecting trash.

shot.fallback: knight lounging at an judgment site

lines.text: That's the same man who watched a hundred thousand people get hunted and called it a game.

shot.fallback: stern commander glaring at nobles

lines.text: The Nobles he punishes are the ones who defend commoners. The ones who hunt them get promoted.

shot.fallback: nobles cheering at an judgment

lines.text: I think that's the cleanest picture of how the World Government's value system works.

shot.search: World Government Mary Geoise Celestial Dragons
shot.fallback: grand holy city under a cold sky

lines.text: Cruelty to commoners is normal. Mercy to commoners is a crime.

shot.fallback: noble sneering at commoners

lines.text: Rewind fifteen years, and Shanks finally arrives in Mary Geoise. Garling is ecstatic.

shot.fallback: old noble greeting a red haired man

lines.text: He tells his son he can have anything and should forget the surface and everyone he loved there.

shot.fallback: old noble offering anything to his son

lines.text: He honestly believes Shanks suffered a lifetime of hardship in the Lower World.

shot.fallback: old noble pitying a scarred pirate

lines.text: He even launched missions to take Shanks back from the Roger Pirates, and the Knights were repelled every time.

shot.search: Knights of God Roger Pirates repelled Shanks
shot.fallback: knights failing against a pirate crew

lines.text: This is what doesn't fit the villain stereotype: he does care about his sons.

shot.fallback: stern father with two red haired sons

lines.text: But the care is possession. He wants them to take their birthright, and a mother is just an obstacle.

shot.search: Garling Shamrock Shanks birthright World Nobles
shot.fallback: father presenting a throne to sons

lines.text: Then comes Egghead. After that incident, Garling receives orders to become the new Warrior God of Science and Defense.

shot.search: Garling Warrior God of Science and Defense
shot.fallback: new elder taking his seat

lines.text: He succeeds Saturn, walks into the Room of Authority and addresses the other Elders as equals.

shot.search: Garling Room of Authority Five Elders equals
shot.fallback: new elder walking into a chamber of elders

lines.text: They're outraged, until he reveals he has taken Saturn's title.

shot.search: Five Elders outraged Garling Saturn title
shot.fallback: elders recoiling at a newcomer

lines.text: The champion of the hunt is now one of the five highest authorities in the world.

shot.fallback: five elders seated with a new member

lines.text: And the bill for God Valley still hasn't come due...

shot.fallback: sunken island under dark water

lines.text: Let me steelman him, because there is a fair counterargument.

shot.fallback: thoughtful knight under red light

lines.text: The wiki says what Garling actually did in the incident beyond the Rocks kill is still unknown.

shot.search: Garling God Valley Incident role unknown
shot.fallback: knight half hidden in shadow

lines.text: And the champion title may not have been a reward at all, just the Nobles' tidy label for a favorite who survived.

shot.search: Garling champion title Native Hunting Competition
shot.fallback: trophy in a noble hall

lines.text: The Elder seat also came from Imu's orders, not a vote, so maybe the Elders never chose him.

shot.fallback: shadowy king on a throne giving orders

lines.text: That's a fair point, and I won't pretend otherwise.

shot.fallback: knight bowing to a throne

lines.text: But Imu knew about the Davy Family because Garling reported it, which is Chapter 1158.

shot.fallback: king receiving a report in darkness

lines.text: And Imu's purpose on that island was to end the Davy line. Garling delivered the target.

shot.search: Imu Davy family line Rocks Teach Eris
shot.fallback: king ordering a family's end

lines.text: So even if the seat was ordered rather than earned, the order rewards that delivery.

shot.fallback: king handing a seat to a knight

lines.text: Chapter 1162 shows he can't beat Rocks, so strength didn't earn him that seat.

shot.fallback: knight overpowered by a pirate

lines.text: What's left is the one thing he did well: he found the enemy, and he served the king.

shot.fallback: loyal knight kneeling before a king

lines.text: That makes the seat feel less like a victory and more like a payment.

shot.fallback: elder seat glowing in darkness

lines.text: So what does that tell us about what Garling will do when the next order comes?

shot.fallback: elder staring at a distant island

lines.text: In the Elbaph arc, Garling is the Elder who backs Imu without a flicker of doubt.

shot.fallback: elder standing behind a throne

lines.text: When Imu decides to go to the Lower World himself, the other Elders are horrified.

shot.search: Five Elders horrified Imu goes Elbaph
shot.fallback: elders shocked at their king's decision

lines.text: Garling tells them they have no right to stop their ruler.

shot.search: Garling Five Elders no right stop Imu
shot.fallback: elder silencing the others

lines.text: That's loyalty again, and loyalty is the only skill that ever got him anywhere.

shot.fallback: elder bowing to a throne

lines.text: He also scolds York for being hungry and says her hunger is punishment for the original Vegapunk's part in all this.

shot.fallback: elder scolding a hungry woman

lines.text: Same man, same move: a cruelty dressed up as policy.

shot.fallback: elder coldly dismissing a worker

lines.text: He believes Nika's return through Luffy is the cause of every recent disaster.

shot.fallback: elder pointing at a laughing hero

lines.text: Think about what that sets up. Shanks stands on the other side of that war, and Garling still pities him.

shot.fallback: red haired pirate facing an old noble

lines.text: My prediction: the first person Garling truly fails to control won't be Luffy. It'll be a son.

shot.fallback: two red haired men facing their father

lines.text: Dragon, Shanks, Teach, Kuma. Every survivor of that hunt is walking back into the story.

shot.search: Dragon Shanks Teach Kuma God Valley survivors
shot.fallback: four survivors walking out of smoke

lines.text: Garling built his whole career on one hunt, and the people he hunted are the ones coming back for him.

shot.search: Garling angry Five Elders God Valley
shot.fallback: old noble confronted by his past

lines.text: And if you want the full climb from Knight to Elder, that's the next story.

shot.fallback: knight climbing a staircase to an elder's seat

published.comment: Was Garling ever the hero of God Valley, or just the last man standing when the credit got handed out?
